text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohooo...?

After safely finishing her Debut,
Wonder Acute stared blankly
at somewhere other than the stands.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, Acute-san?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Look, over there...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's a huge TV. Look, we're on screen...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So, you're saying our race was being broadcast
on living room TVs across the country?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text: No. That's the Turf Vision... It shows footage you can only see right here at the venue.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Who Ran Together
text_block_list.text: It might get a satellite broadcast, but small races like the Make Debut don't air on national TV.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho, so that's how it is...
Wonder Acute wore an impressed expression.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I was on TV, but...
I wasn't really on TV, you knoow."

I kind of understood what she meant.
Did she really want to be on TV
that badly?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't broadcast to living rooms nationwide.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I guess you really won't see me, not in a hospital room.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's right. I really wanted to show the grandpas and grandmas in rehab how hard I was trying, but...
It seemed Wonder Acute wanted to show herself running to inspire everyone aiming for a comeback.
choice_data_list: Did you invite everyone from the boxing gym?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"About today's race?
No, I haven't done that at all~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Everrryone's doing their best for tomorrow, so we shouldn't get in their way.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They won't notice me from far away right now...
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess it just means I'll have to get
much, much stronger myself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So that my "Go for it, go for it!"
can reach them loud and clear through the TV.
—A nationwide broadcast on terrestrial TV. It's no easy feat to be featured as glamorously on dirt as on turf.
Even as a novice, as a Trainer, I knew very well...
And the sun set over the racetrack—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
This path sure looks like it'll be a long, long one, huh.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that we won't make it in time
unless we run as fast as we can?
If that's the case..."
A frantic tempo doesn't suit Wonder Acute. Her greatest strength is—her inner calm.

"That is precisely why she can endure hard training.
In that case, the best path forward would be..."
choice_data_list: First, let's build up some race experience.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Racing experience...
Are you really alright with that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
Then let's do just that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's fine by me, whatever you think is best.
Let's try out all sorts of things together, you and I.

Wonder Acute's gentle smile,
all-embracing and warm.
First, let's keep entering races and steadily build up your strength.
